Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de electrocasnice, electrice și electronice
Miele Tehnica is a subsidiary of Miele & Cie. KG, Germany. We produce electronic components for a wide range of Miele appliances, such as washing machines, tumble dryers, vacuum cleaners, ovens and others. The products Miele offers to its customers set the standards for durability, performance, ease of use, energy efficiency, design and service.
 As part of the Business Unit Professional IT , we are building and evolving Salesforce into a strategic platform that supports customer engagement, sales, and field service operations across Miele Professional. By combining modern Salesforce technologies, enterprise integrations, and engineering best practices, we deliver scalable digital solutions that support business growth worldwide.
 In this position, you will help shape the future of our Salesforce platform from the beginning. Working closely with Product Owners, Solution Owners, Application Consultants, Architects, and business stakeholders, you will design, develop, and enhance enterprise-grade Salesforce solutions while contributing to modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous platform innovation.
 Key Responsibilities: 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and Salesforce APIs.
Develop custom functionality while maximizing the use of standard Salesforce capabilities.
Build integrations between Salesforce and enterprise platforms such as SAP, middleware, and third-party applications.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Solution Owners, and Application Consultants to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
Participate in solution design, estimation, architecture discussions, and code reviews.
Build reusable components and promote development standards that improve engineering efficiency.
Support CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve platform stability, security, and performance.
Explore and adopt modern AI-assisted development practices to improve software quality and developer productivity.
 What You'll Bring :
At least 5 years of professional software development experience , including 3+ years developing Salesforce solutions .
Strong experience with Apex , Lightning Web Components (LWC) , SOQL , SOSL , and Salesforce APIs.
Experience developing enterprise Salesforce applications.
Knowledge of Salesforce Flows and declarative platform capabilities.
Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise applications using REST or SOAP APIs.
Understanding of Salesforce platform architecture, governor limits, and performance optimization.
Experience working with Git, source-driven development, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and collaborative mindset.
Good written and spoken English.
 Nice to Have: 
Salesforce Platform Developer I certification.
Salesforce Platform Developer II certification.
Salesforce JavaScript Developer I certification.
Salesforce Application Architect certification.
Experience with Salesforce DX, DevOps Center, Copado, Gearset, or similar deployment tools.
Experience integrating Salesforce with SAP, MuleSoft, Azure Integration Services, or comparable middleware.
Familiarity with modern frontend technologies and enterprise cloud platforms.
Interest in AI-assisted software engineering and developer productivity tools.
German language skills.
 Technology Stack: 
Salesforce Platform
Apex
Lightning Web Components (LWC)
Salesforce Flows
SOQL / SOSL
REST & SOAP APIs
Platform Events
Git
Salesforce DX
DevOps Center
Copado / Gearset
SAP Integrations
MuleSoft
Azure Integration Services
GitHub Copilot / AI-assisted Development
 Education :
 You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline—or equivalent professional experience in Salesforce development and enterprise software engineering.
 Why Join Miele? 
Help shape a strategic Salesforce platform supporting global sales and service operations.
Work with modern Salesforce technologies, enterprise integrations, and cloud-based solutions.
Collaborate with international cross-functional teams in a product-driven environment.
Contribute to modern engineering practices including DevOps, automation, and AI-assisted software development.
Build your career within an innovative, internationally recognized company that values long-term growth and continuous learning.
